items.question: Which WNBA teams has Moriah Jefferson played for?
items.answer: Moriah Jefferson has played for the San Antonio Stars, Las Vegas Aces, Dallas Wings, Minnesota Lynx, Phoenix Mercury, Connecticut Sun and Chicago Sky.

items.question: Where did Moriah Jefferson play college basketball?
items.answer: Moriah Jefferson played at UConn, where the Huskies went 151-5 and won four straight NCAA championships from 2013 to 2016. She won the Nancy Lieberman Award as the nation's top point guard in 2015 and 2016.

items.question: When did Moriah Jefferson last play in the WNBA?
items.answer: Moriah Jefferson's last WNBA games came with the Chicago Sky in 2025. The Sky waived her on July 28, 2025.

items.question: What are Moriah Jefferson's WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Moriah Jefferson averaged 8.3 points, 1.9 rebounds and 3.3 assists in 207 WNBA regular-season games from 2016 to 2025. Her best season was her 2016 rookie year with San Antonio, at 13.9 points per game.

items.question: How tall is Moriah Jefferson?
items.answer: Basketball-Reference lists Moriah Jefferson at 5 feet 6 inches. She plays point guard.

items.question: How old is Moriah Jefferson?
items.answer: Moriah Jefferson was born March 8, 1994, in Glenn Heights, Texas.

items.question: Where did Moriah Jefferson go to high school?
items.answer: Moriah Jefferson was homeschooled and played five varsity seasons for the Texas Home Educators Sports Association (THESA) Riders.
